hook.name: RaffleTaxHookEth
hook.description: Collects a fixed ETH tax (feeBps, capped at 5%) on every swap in native-ETH pools, redirecting the fee into the contract as a raffle prize pot. Taxes are taken via BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta across all four swap shapes; the fee rate is immutable after deployment, and the operator can withdraw accrued ETH via collect().
